messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads-up: during a quick audit I noticed a handful of object-store snapshots in the staging account tagged with `encrypted:false` — not customer-facing but we should treat as an S3/R2 snapshot policy gap.
jon (infra): ouch. which snapshots and which workflow created them?
paul (backup): that would be automated daily snapshot job `backup->snapshot-service` for the old test tenants. I pushed a quick grep, looks like 2026-03-14 02:00 UTC run produced 6 objects.
lee (platform): are those DB snapshots (RDS style) or object-store volume snapshots?
paul (backup): object-store (S3-compatible) incremental snapshots. We normally encrypt at rest with our KMS CMK, but the job fell back to plaintext because the IAM role lacked kms:Encrypt on the new test key alias.
maria (sec-eng): ok that explains. we need immediate containment + org-wide checklist to avoid restore/exfil risk.
ashley (sre): containment plan: 1) block public access to the bucket, 2) add lifecycle to quarantine objects, 3) rotate the alias mapping so restores require approval. I'll start the bucket ACL lock.
jon (infra): i'll add a temporary Deny in the bucket policy for any PutObject without x-amz-server-side-encryption header so new unencrypted snapshots fail. Example: `Condition: { "StringNotEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms"}}`
maria (sec-eng): good. also need RBAC change: create two short-lived roles — `snapshot-remediate` (can read+encrypt+tag) and `snapshot-audit` (read-only). We'll restrict assume-role to sec-eng + oncall until we finish the postmortem.
lee (platform): for longer-term, we should add a validation hook in the snapshot service that fails if target KMS key is not configured or key policy denies encrypt. I'll open a platform PR.
paul (backup): note: the automation used alias `alias/backups-test` which was rotated yesterday. The new key's key policy didn't include the snapshot service's role. I'll patch that now.
kms-bot: INFO: Key alias `alias/backups-test` rotated by infra-bot at 2026-03-13T23:41:12Z. Rotation triggered key_policy_update_workflow.
maria (sec-eng): add audit logging tasks: ensure CloudTrail (or equivalent) delivers KMS Encrypt/Decrypt events + S3 PutObject events to our secure audit bucket with retention 3y, and ensure the logs are immutably archived (WORM).
jon (infra): checklist item added to infra-runbook: `verify_kms_permissions`, `block_unencrypted_puts`, `re-tag_quarantined_objects`, `trigger_key_policy_review`.
ashley (sre): incident response note: if any customer-facing snapshot was impacted, escalate to legal + CS. Currently this is internal test tenants only — no PII observed.
maria (sec-eng): let's triage vuln classification: cause = mis-synced key policy on rotation. severity = medium (internal data exposure risk). Action owner: paul. ETA for fix = 4h.
paul (backup): working on adding kms:Encrypt to role `snapshot-service-role` for alias `alias/backups-test`. will also re-run the job with encryption enforced and then move the objects to encrypted bucket.
lee (platform): can we add an automated pre-rotation check to fail rotation if any roles referenced by services are not in the new key policy?
jon (infra): yes, that's a good guardrail. we can implement a step in the rotation pipeline: `dryrun: validate-role-access(new_key_arn)` and fail rotation if mismatches found.
maria (sec-eng): long-term controls: 1) require `sse=kms` at service-level for all snapshot-pipeline configs, 2) daily audit job that lists unencrypted objects and alerts; 3) RBAC review for keys quarterly.
ashley (sre): i've added a runbook task for oncall to check `alerts/unencrypted_snapshots` slack channel and run `scripts/quarantine_unencrypted.sh` if triggered. Put it in the oncall rotation playbook.
paul (backup): fixed: role patched, re-run complete. the 6 affected objects were re-encrypted and re-uploaded to `s3://backups-quarantine/encrypted-2026-03-14/` with tags `remediated:true`.
maria (sec-eng): nice. please attach a short remediation note with the S3 object ARNs + KMS Encrypt event IDs to the ticket. We'll run a mini postmortem and include a one-page update for risk committee.
lee (platform): PR opened for pre-rotation validation and a unit test harness for the snapshot service. link: https://git.redwood.dev/platform/ops/merge/1227
jon (infra): scheduling: I'll add infra-check to the monthly infra runbook to scan key policies vs service roles.
maria (sec-eng): thanks team. final ask: add the RBAC change to IAM audit rotation — create `backup-admin` and `backup-restore-runner` roles with limited assume principals, and log role assumption events for 365d.
paul (backup): noted. will follow up with PR and add the ticket: #INC-2026-503.
maria (sec-eng): closing notes: no customer impact, remediation complete, follow-up items assigned. I'll schedule the 1-pager and present at next security sync. :white_check_mark:
ashley (sre): :thumbsup:
jon (infra): :+1:
